concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one polished approval preview of a completely redesigned VizMP desktop music-player skin. Landscape 2048x1152, true 2K detail, crisp UI, richly detailed original digital character illustration. Single app composition, orthographic front view, not a monitor photograph. Neutral charcoal desktop backdrop outside the custom-shaped borderless app. Authentic premium 2000s Winamp custom skin craftsmanship translated into modern high-DPI rendering: sculpted metallic bevels, precise tactile buttons, a restrained LCD track readout, modular detached playlist and EQ panels. The artwork is a large dominant feature integrated into the OUTER silhouette and margins, not a tiny logo repeated in rectangular headers. Use a creative asymmetric layout that could be implemented in Godot: main deck with Previous, Play/Pause, Next, seek and volume controls; playlist with five readable tracks; a six-band equalizer module; small minimize/maximize/close buttons and draggable top rail. Keep all controls readable and unobscured by character art, leave logical hit areas and useful spacing. Visualizer is minimized: only a small dedicated VIS button, no giant visualizer rectangle. Main title VIZMP; skin name legible. Minimal other text. This is a static visual design proposal, not an implemented UI. No watermarks, no unrelated logos, no generic rounded dashboard cards. All human characters are original clearly adult women in their late twenties with mature facial proportions, stylish non-explicit clothing; no school uniforms or childlike characters. Skin 01: NOCTURNE. Adult black-haired woman, sophisticated face, luminous violet eyes, exquisite fine hair strands and detailed dark leather jacket over a high-neck fitted black outfit, ornate lace sleeves, confident relaxed standing pose. Elegant anime/illustrative realism inspired by premium neon-noir character art. Character occupies the full left third with hair and shoulder breaking outside the sculpted frame. Black titanium, smoked glass, deep plum, tiny magenta and icy cyan edge lights. Central low horizontal deck wraps along the character's right side; stepped playlist on upper right, floating precision EQ lower right. Art-lit midnight city fragments behind the portrait only, restrained reflections, dark uncluttered negative space. Make it a beautiful custom art object with technically legible controls, not a generic app template.

production_assets.character_brief: Faithfully recreate only the approved original adult character and ornament. Remove every player panel, screen, control and text. Transparent background requested, portrait composition, highest available resolution.
production_assets.frame_brief: One empty orthographic panel frame matching the approved skin. No characters, text, buttons, sliders or icons. Empty dark glass center, transparent exterior, straight edges for nine-slice scaling; detailed theme-specific corner ornaments.
production_assets.source_sizes: Character assets 1024 x 1536; frame assets 1536 x 1024. Actual Godot UI captures tested at 2048 x 1280 and 3840 x 2160. These are not claimed as native 4K generated illustrations.
